description:
Title: Ordering in an Online Shop  

A customer that logs into an E-Shop system and has to wait for its login confirmation (its credentials are checked by the system).
If the login was successful then the customer can continue to select products, else the shopping experience stops.
After selecting a product the customer has to add it to a shopping cart, save the product and check if every product was already selected.
These steps repeat until all products were selected.
Then the order is finished by the shopping system and simultaneously payment and shipment for the order is prepared.
For the payment the customer has to enter its payment data and has to wait until the bank confirms the payment.
While waiting for the payment confirmation the customer can enter its shipping address (an independent billing address can be entered if the shipping address is not equal to the billing address).
Finally if the address and the payment steps are executed then the order will be finished by the system.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OnlineShop" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/online-shop-ordering">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginData" name="Login data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginSuccess" name="Login successful"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginFailed" name="Login failed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderSubmitted" name="Order submitted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentData" name="Payment data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentConfirmed" name="Payment confirmed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShippingAddress" name="Shipping address"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OnlineShop" name="Ordering in an Online Shop">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_EShop" name="E-Shop System" processRef="Process_EShop"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Bank"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_LoginData" name="Login data" sourceRef="SendTask_SendLoginData" targetRef="MsgStart_LoginData"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_LoginSuccess" name="Login successful" sourceRef="SendTask_SendLoginSuccess" targetRef="Catch_LoginSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_LoginFailed" name="Login failed" sourceRef="SendTask_SendLoginFailed" targetRef="Catch_LoginFailed"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OrderSubmitted" name="Order submitted" sourceRef="SendTask_SubmitOrder" targetRef="MsgStart_OrderSubmitted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentData" name="Payment data" sourceRef="SendTask_SendPaymentData" targetRef="Participant_Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentConfirmedToCustomer" name="Payment confirmed" sourceRef="Participant_Bank" targetRef="Catch_PaymentConfirmed_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentConfirmedToShop" name="Payment confirmed" sourceRef="Participant_Bank" targetRef="Catch_PaymentConfirmed_EShop"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ShippingAddress" name="Shipping address" sourceRef="SendTask_SendShippingAddress" targetRef="Catch_ShippingAddress_EShop"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CustomerLogin" name="Login requested"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterLogin" name="Enter login credentials"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendLoginData" name="Send login data" messageRef="Message_LoginData"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="EGW_LoginWait" name="Wait for login result"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_LoginSuccess" name="Login successful">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_LoginSuccess" messageRef="Message_LoginSuccess"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_LoginFailed" name="Login failed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_LoginFailed" messageRef="Message_LoginFailed"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ShoppingStopped" name="Shopping stopped"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Merge_ProductSelection" name="Product selection merge"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectProduct" name="Select product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddToCart" name="Add product to shopping cart"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAllSelected" name="Check whether all products were selected"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_AllSelected" name="All products selected?" default="Flow_ProductsRemaining"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SubmitOrder" name="Submit order" messageRef="Message_OrderSubmitted"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterPayment" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendPaymentData" name="Send payment data" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="PGW_PaymentSplit" name="Split payment and address steps"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_PaymentConfirmed_Customer" name="Payment confirmed by bank">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PaymentConfirmedCustomer" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmed"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterShippingAddress" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_BillingAddressNeeded" name="Shipping address differs from billing address?" default="Flow_BillingSameAsShipping"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBillingAddress" name="Enter billing address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Merge_Address" name="Address merge"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendShippingAddress" name="Send shipping address" messageRef="Message_ShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="PGW_PaymentJoin" name="Join payment and address steps"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerDone" name="Order steps completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C01" sourceRef="Start_CustomerLogin" targetRef="Task_EnterLogin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C02" sourceRef="Task_EnterLogin" targetRef="SendTask_SendLoginData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C03" sourceRef="SendTask_SendLoginData" targetRef="EGW_LoginWait"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C04" sourceRef="EGW_LoginWait" targetRef="Catch_LoginSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C05" sourceRef="EGW_LoginWait" targetRef="Catch_LoginFailed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C06" sourceRef="Catch_LoginFailed" targetRef="End_ShoppingStopped"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C07" sourceRef="Catch_LoginSuccess" targetRef="Merge_ProductSelection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C08" sourceRef="Merge_ProductSelection" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C09" sourceRef="Task_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C10" sourceRef="Task_AddToCart" targetRef="Task_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C11" sourceRef="Task_SaveProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckAllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C12" sourceRef="Task_CheckAllSelected" targetRef="GW_AllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProductsRemaining" name="No" sourceRef="GW_AllSelected" targetRef="Merge_ProductSelection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllProductsSelected" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_AllSelected" targetRef="SendTask_SubmitOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allProductsSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C15" sourceRef="SendTask_SubmitOrder" targetRef="Task_EnterPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C16" sourceRef="Task_EnterPayment" targetRef="SendTask_SendPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C17" sourceRef="SendTask_SendPaymentData" targetRef="PGW_PaymentSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C18" sourceRef="PGW_PaymentSplit" targetRef="Catch_PaymentConfirmed_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C19" sourceRef="PGW_PaymentSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C20" sourceRef="Catch_PaymentConfirmed_Customer" targetRef="PGW_PaymentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C21" sourceRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress" targetRef="GW_BillingAddressNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingSameAsShipping" name="Same" sourceRef="GW_BillingAddressNeeded" targetRef="Merge_Address"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingDiffers" name="Different" sourceRef="GW_BillingAddressNeeded" targetRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${billingAddressDiffers}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C24" sourceRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress" targetRef="Merge_Address"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C25" sourceRef="Merge_Address" targetRef="SendTask_SendShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C26" sourceRef="SendTask_SendShippingAddress" targetRef="PGW_PaymentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C27" sourceRef="PGW_PaymentJoin" targetRef="End_CustomerDone"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_EShop" name="E-Shop System" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="MsgStart_LoginData" name="Login data received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_LoginDataReceived" messageRef="Message_LoginData"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckCredentials" name="Check credentials"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_LoginValid" name="Login successful?" default="Flow_LoginRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendLoginSuccess" name="Send login confirmation" messageRef="Message_LoginSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendLoginFailed" name="Send login failure" messageRef="Message_LoginFailed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LoginConfirmed" name="Login confirmed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LoginRejected" name="Login rejected"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="MsgStart_OrderSubmitted" name="Order submitted">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderSubmitted" messageRef="Message_OrderSubmitted"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinishOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="PGW_PrepareSplit" name="Split payment and shipment preparation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_PaymentConfirmed_EShop" name="Payment confirmed by bank">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PaymentConfirmedShop" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmed"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ShippingAddress_EShop" name="Shipping address received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ShippingAddressReceived" messageRef="Message_ShippingAddress"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="PGW_PrepareJoin" name="Join payment and shipment preparation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteOrder" name="Complete order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderCompleted" name="Order completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S01" sourceRef="MsgStart_LoginData" targetRef="Task_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S02" sourceRef="Task_CheckCredentials" targetRef="GW_LoginValid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginAccepted" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_LoginValid" targetRef="SendTask_SendLoginSuccess">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${credentialsValid}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginRejected" name="No" sourceRef="GW_LoginValid" targetRef="SendTask_SendLoginFailed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S05" sourceRef="SendTask_SendLoginSuccess" targetRef="End_LoginConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S06" sourceRef="SendTask_SendLoginFailed" targetRef="End_LoginRejected"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S07" sourceRef="MsgStart_OrderSubmitted" targetRef="Task_FinishOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S08" sourceRef="Task_FinishOrder" targetRef="PGW_PrepareSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S09" sourceRef="PGW_PrepareSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S10" sourceRef="PGW_PrepareSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S11" sourceRef="Task_PreparePayment" targetRef="Catch_PaymentConfirmed_EShop"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S12" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShipment" targetRef="Catch_ShippingAddress_EShop"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S13" sourceRef="Catch_PaymentConfirmed_EShop" targetRef="PGW_PrepareJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S14" sourceRef="Catch_ShippingAddress_EShop" targetRef="PGW_PrepareJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S15" sourceRef="PGW_PrepareJoin" targetRef="Task_CompleteOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S16" sourceRef="Task_CompleteOrder" targetRef="End_OrderCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
